Specification: This specification models a PlusCal algorithm in which N concurrent processes increment a shared variable x by 1 using a binary semaphore sem for mutual exclusion. Each process repeatedly follows the translated control flow lock, p1, p2, and unlock, storing the shared value temporarily in a local per-process variable t before writing back x := t[self] + 1. The spec assumes N is a positive natural number, defines the standard initial condition and next-state relation from the PlusCal translation, permits infinite stuttering after all processes reach Done to avoid deadlock on termination, and asserts a temporal termination property that eventually every process reaches Done.
